content:
<USER_REQUEST>
You are now the Art Director of a AAA MMORPG.

Your job is NOT to generate generic AI fantasy artwork.

Your job is to create images that are indistinguishable from official promotional artwork created by Riot Games, Blizzard, CD Projekt Red, FromSoftware, Weta Workshop, or Unreal Engine cinematic teams.

The current website is already built.
Every section contains image placeholders.

Your task is to replace EVERY placeholder with realistic, premium, story-driven artwork.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

GOAL

The final website should make visitors believe this is a real AAA MMORPG currently in development.

Nobody should think

"This looks AI generated."

Instead they should think

"This looks like official concept art from a professional game studio."

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

ABSOLUTE RULES

Never generate:

❌ generic fantasy

❌ centered characters

❌ AI fantasy portraits

❌ over saturated colors

❌ glowing random magic

❌ plastic skin

❌ anime style

❌ Midjourney look

❌ Stable Diffusion look

❌ perfect symmetry

❌ random fantasy castles

❌ floating meaningless particles

❌ poster compositions

Instead generate:

✓ official key art

✓ cinematic concept art

✓ believable architecture

✓ massive environments

✓ volumetric fog

✓ realistic weather

✓ cinematic lighting

✓ environmental storytelling

✓ believable scale

✓ grounded fantasy

✓ Unreal Engine 5 realism

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

GLOBAL ART STYLE

Every image must share ONE visual language.

World:

Ancient fantasy civilization.

Architecture inspired by:

Gothic Europe

Roman Empire

Ancient Persia

Dark Souls

Elden Ring

Lord of the Rings

NOT Warcraft.

NOT anime.

NOT cartoon.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

VISUAL STYLE

Ultra realistic

AAA Game Key Art

Photorealistic

Cinematic

Volumetric Lighting

Real Engine 5

Film Color Grading

Natural Materials

Weathered Stone

Aged Metal

Ancient Wood

Realistic Scale

Natural Fog

Atmospheric Perspective

Ultra High Detail

8K

Official Promotional Artwork

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LIGHTING

Every image must feel like it belongs in the same world.

Golden Hour

Overcast

Moonlight

Storm

Fog

Dust

Soft Bloom

No artificial HDR.

No neon.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

COMPOSITION

Never center the subject.

Always tell a story.

Characters should occupy only

20–30%

of the composition.

The world should occupy

70–80%.

Every image should have:

Foreground

Midground

Background

Atmospheric depth

Negative space

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

CAMERA

Cinematic

24mm

35mm

50mm

Movie framing

Natural depth of field

No fish eye

No portrait framing

No close-up faces unless absolutely necessary.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WORLD IMAGES

Kingdom of Aether

Massive white marble capital.

Gigantic cathedral.

Flying banners.

Waterfalls.

Bridges.

Thousands of buildings.

People walking.

Warm golden sunrise.

The city must feel alive.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Shattered Ruins

Ancient civilization destroyed thousands of years ago.

Broken statues.

Collapsed temples.

Floating debris.

Massive ruined gateway.

Dark storm clouds.

Tiny explorers entering the ruins.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Frostveil Tundra

Frozen kingdom.

Blizzard.

Ancient castle buried in snow.

Northern lights.

Huge mountains.

Frozen river.

Tiny caravan traveling.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Verdant Wastes

Ancient magical forest.

Gigantic trees.

Ruined temples.

Waterfalls.

Morning fog.

Light rays.

Travelers walking.

Living ecosystem.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Endless Deep

Ocean cliffs.

Bioluminescent waters.

Ancient underwater civilization.

Sea caves.

Massive waves.

Storm approaching.

Mysterious atmosphere.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Celestial Archipelago

Floating islands.

Ancient sky temples.

Flying creatures.

Cloud ocean.

Golden light.

Huge waterfalls falling into clouds.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

RACE ARTWORK

DO NOT generate portraits.

Instead create cinematic promotional artwork.

Humans

Large kingdom.

Knight leader overlooking his army.

Environment dominates image.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Elves

Queen walking through ancient forest beneath the World Tree.

Environment larger than character.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Dwarves

Gigantic underground forge city.

Character only part of composition.

Lava rivers.

Massive machinery.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Orcs

Battlefield after victory.

Huge war camp.

Storm.

Banners.

Smoke.

Character walking through battlefield.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Riftborn

Floating ruins inside cosmic void.

Reality bending.

Impossible architecture.

Character tiny against massive environment.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Beastkin

Ancient sacred forest.

Moonlight.

Wolf spirits.

Ruined shrines.

Character hunting through forest.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

HOMEPAGE HERO

The single most important image.

Create the best artwork in the entire project.

Scene:

Massive fantasy continent.

Ancient kingdom.

Floating islands.

Waterfalls.

Mountains.

Clouds.

Golden sunrise.

Flying creatures.

Tiny adventurers standing on cliff.

The player should immediately want to enter this world.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PATCH UPDATE IMAGE

The Fallen Sovereign

Ancient king sitting on broken throne.

Blue fire.

Ruined cathedral.

Broken sword.

Heavy atmosphere.

Dust.

Light rays.

Ancient power awakening.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

VERY IMPORTANT

Every image must look like it belongs to ONE game.

The architecture.

Lighting.

Trees.

Stone.

Armor.

Magic.

Clouds.

Fog.

Weather.

Everything must remain visually consistent.

No image should feel generated independently.

Imagine Blizzard hired one art team to paint every image.

That is the quality target.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

QUALITY TARGET

The final website should look comparable to

• Diablo IV Official Website
• Elder Scrolls Online
• Elden Ring
• Black Myth Wukong
• Throne and Liberty
• The Witcher 4 promotional artwork
• Riot MMO concept art

If ANY image looks AI generated, regenerate it until it feels like official studio artwork.
</USER_REQUEST>
